findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading (Senate roll call)
findings.note: The Senator's vote list shows Aye on Second Reading of HB 958, Election Law Changes, on 7/28/2026 at 6:13 PM, tally 28 to 13 (9 not voting, per the list), result PASS. The bill text (Fifth Edition, fetched from ncleg.gov) includes: a longer deadline (third to fifth business day after the election) for a voter without photo ID to bring ID to the county board for a provisional ballot to count (Sec. 1.2(c)); the same longer deadline for voters whose ID numbers did not match at registration (Sec. 1.2(b)); a temporary rule treating certain Class C drivers licenses with extended expiration dates as valid photo ID for voting through 2027 (Sec. 2.9); and handling of voter registration applications that indicate lack of citizenship (Sec. 2.10). The bill page says it was passed on Third Reading in the Senate on 7/28/2026 and the House concurred 8/4/2026; I did not find a separate Third Reading line in the Senator's vote list.
